name: et-functions-tests
description: Cloud Functions tests. Run against the local emulators under a demo- project id, so they can never touch production.

scripts.test: cd ../.. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-et "node tests/functions/order-gate.test.cjs && node tests/functions/hub-location.test.cjs && node tests/functions/dispute.test.cjs && node tests/functions/farm-documents.test.cjs && node tests/functions/order-v2.test.cjs && node tests/functions/order-flow.test.cjs && node tests/functions/notifications.test.cjs && node tests/functions/reviews.test.cjs && node tests/functions/group-buy.test.cjs && node tests/functions/push.test.cjs && node tests/functions/delete-account.test.cjs && node tests/functions/delete-lot.test.cjs"
